source_lock_contracts.reason: The frozen Rust boundary has typed frame identity and callback-free transaction ownership; scene, transport, scheduler, and cancellation capabilities remain an explicit integration boundary.
source_lock_contracts.nonportable_boundary: BattleScene, CoopTransport, injected scheduler, and AbortSignal are browser capabilities; no Rust campaign pass is claimed.

source_lock_contracts.reason: All eight authenticated context fields are represented by the frozen FrameContext DTO and separate equality/compatibility entrypoints.
The typed entry body, context reattachment, revision, material, successor, and subsumption fields are frozen; revision ownership is the AuthorityLog seam.
Material keeps a required digest and required JSON payload key, including explicit JSON null; adapter-specific image validation is not silently invented here.
source_lock_contracts.nonportable_boundary: Concrete adapter image validators and digests remain outside the frozen er-protocol DTO boundary.

source_lock_contracts.reason: Receipt stage and optional non-null control identity are typed separately from authority-side semantic quorum intake.
All five closed control variants and their typed address fields are frozen; successor validation and identity are named Rust functions.
Owner seat, stable Pokémon identity, and field index are carried as typed coordinates; the target is not a display label.
The immutable replacement tail retains operation identity, boundary coordinates, occurrence ordering, and field ownership.
Surface class, closed operation kind, owner, coordinate, successor kinds, and explicit wildcard IDs remain one typed control claim.
source_lock_contracts.nonportable_boundary: The live phase/handler generation proof belongs to the browser projector adapter after Rust accepts the stated control.

source_lock_contracts.reason: Required after-operation identity, coordinates, allowlists, next-wave flag, and nullable expected operation identity are separate fields.
Terminal identity is a non-empty typed control and is legal only for a TERMINAL_COMMIT successor.
The frozen envelope remains v/t/ctx/body with lossless opaque body JSON; typed validation is an additional view.
Request identity, captured frontier, and reason are typed before correlated recovery effects are emitted.
The bundle has required nullable frontier identity and control fields, context inheritance, material, membership, and a retained tail.
The correlated frontier/material/control proof is typed as completion evidence and is explicitly not AuthorityLog retirement evidence.
The Rust target is the opaque digest-bearing material capsule and entry draft; typed turn image fields remain adapter-owned.
source_lock_contracts.nonportable_boundary: BattleScene capture, mutation tokens, and adapter-specific FNV-1a64 image selection are not implemented by this M2A map lane.

source_lock_contracts.reason: Wave and terminal payload fields are opaque material; typed entry kind, successor identity, supersession, and retention remain Rust evidence.
